blockers: Critical implementation defects require a repair slice before acceptance.

evidence.outcome: PASS: bundled Node TypeScript noEmit completed with exit code 0.
Vite build failed separately with EPERM writing node_modules/.vite-temp; no source change made.

FAIL: startup only validates/materializes mod settings when the JSON artifact already exists; missing artifact permits startup and omits --mod-settings, violating fail-closed startup and mandatory binary input.

FAIL: each setting is written directly as a primitive under the scope dictionary. Factorio's documented mod-settings structure requires scope dictionaries containing mod-setting entries, whose value is represented by the setting's value property; the generated tree is therefore malformed for Factorio.

The documented format requires an 8-byte version, false flag, and root Dictionary with startup, runtime-global, and runtime-per-user Dictionary sections. The implementation has the header and sections but not the required setting-entry shape.

FAIL: color settings are represented and validated as hex strings and serialized as PropertyTree strings, while Factorio exposes color as a Color value; alpha is also ignored. Missing default_value silently becomes a fallback primitive instead of being rejected.
FAIL: Required is inferred from allowed=true, which is not the Factorio required/default contract; required/default declarations are not reliably enforced during discovery.

Only basic typed validation, unknown ID, and numeric range cases are covered; no test verifies binary PropertyTree decoding, missing-artifact fail-closed startup, color encoding, required/default rejection, or enum/binary round-trip.
PASS: owner/admin authorization, CSRF endpoint filter, explicit stopped confirmation, and 409 conflict while running are present.
PASS: compatibility includes version, expansion, save basename/hash, enabled mod name/version/hash, catalog fingerprint; JSON persistence uses temp file and backup replacement.

next_slice.summary: Repair binary Factorio PropertyTree shape and color representation, enforce fail-closed startup with mandatory materialized input, correct required/default discovery, then add binary/endpoint regression tests.

result: Build and existing tests pass, but critical residual defects prevent acceptance: startup is not fail-closed, and generated mod-settings.dat does not encode Factorio setting values with the required PropertyTree shape; color and required/default handling are also incorrect.
